jobs.description: 등록공장 kind Gold (root ADR-0449; scripts/ops/gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-factories): gold.parcel_factories from silver.registered_factory (the newest edition), when the Silver lane or the served parcel edition moved past the pins the current Gold recorded. It recomputes only the PNUs whose factory rows differ between the pinned and the current edition (and of parcels that entered or left the served edition) and merges them; a change of the code change table rebuilds whole (registered_factory_silver_to_gold.WHOLE_TABLE_INPUTS). Its own job because an own-producer kind is never a table of `kinds` (root ADR-0287 §9). by_pnu_parcel_factories_bake bakes its commit.

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the lane's own full build measured in its cut-over's gold step (the operator's copy of this unit, gold-panel-rebuild.sh parcel-factories): 105 s on 2026-11-09 for 123,451 rows (gold-kind mode=full 77 s). A new Silver release can change every row, so the first run as its unit is taken as a full build again: about six times it, 600 s, inside the 8,100 s share of the 150-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

jobs.description: Reflect each new Gold snapshot of gold.parcel_factories (the own-producer 등록공장 kind, root ADR-0449) in R2 by-PNU serving (scripts/ops/by-pnu-serving-bake.sh parcel-factories), as section packs (root ADR-0147, ADR-0193 §9), exactly as the ownership bake. Its own job, as every own-producer kind's (root ADR-0303 §2). Nothing to do until the operator's first pack-only publish of the lane (root ADR-0190). Started when gold_parcel_factories_rebuild commits a new snapshot, and at 10:55 as the fallback (root ADR-0171). Two slots and MemoryMax=5G, the ownership bake's bound (root ADR-0138).

first_run.estimated_from: computed from the lane's own bakes measured in its cut-over's bake step (by-pnu-pack-operator.sh parcel-factories bake, the same by-pnu-serving-bake.sh): 157 s on 2026-11-09 for 123,451 documents; the first scheduled bake after the publish may cut a whole generation (no reads.jsonl yet, root ADR-0468 §4), so 600 s, inside the 6,210 s share of the 115-minute limit

expected_outcome.no_change_bound_reason: Changes only when its inputs moved. That it is not behind them is the asset reconciler's lag (root ADR-0333) and its lane's behind-inputs bound (root ADR-0444); a change bound here would report a source that published nothing.

assets.title: 필지 등록공장 by-PNU 표
assets.description: PNU마다 그 필지에 주소를 둔 등록공장(회사명·단지명·생산품)을 담는 데이터 종류 표(루트 ADR-0449). 계약의 종류 한 줄(parcel-factories)이 자기 생산자를 이름 짓고, silver.registered_factory 의 가장 새 판에서 만든다. 서빙 필지판의 PNU만, 바뀐 필지만 다시 계산한다.

assets.title: 필지 등록공장 by-PNU 묶음 파일
assets.description: gold.parcel_factories 의 PNU 문서를 법정동 묶음으로만 굽는다. 필지 호스트의 Worker 가 /parcels/factories/by-pnu/ 경로로 서빙한다(루트 ADR-0193, ADR-0449). 첫 발행은 자동 승격(루트 ADR-0435)이 한다.

dependencies.description: 자기 생산자를 가진 종류(루트 ADR-0287 9항, ADR-0449): 가장 새 판의 PNU 가 있는 공장 행을 서빙 필지판의 PNU에만 문서로 묶는다. 고정한 판과 지금 판에서 공장 행이 다른 PNU와 필지판에 들고 난 PNU만 다시 계산한다.
개편으로 바뀐 코드에 걸린 공장 행을 서빙 필지판의 코드로 읽는다(모든 필지 섹션과 같은 renumbered, 루트 ADR-0329 §3). 이 표가 바뀌면 종류를 통째로 짓는다(루트 ADR-0449).
